baselines.B0_no_memory: fixed retry action with no historical training data
baselines.B1_nearest_neighbor: nearest declared training manifestation copies its validated action
baselines.B2_memory_planner: current FailureMemory plus Diagnosis plus RecoveryPlanner
baselines.B3_observable_centroid: action centroid classifier trained only on observable training contexts

D0_exact.description: one declared training manifestation reused as evaluation context

D1_near.description: small surface change from a declared training manifestation

D2_moderate.description: unseen A3/B3/C3 manifestation from the same latent mechanism

D3_large.description: unseen manifestation with larger observable displacement

D4_unrelated.description: context from a different latent mechanism and no shared mechanism label

conditions.C0_no_memory: empty FailureMemory and no episodic training evidence
conditions.C1_training_memory: A1+A2, B1+B2, or C1+C2 available; evaluation A3/B3/C3 is absent
conditions.C2_irrelevant_memory: training experiences from a different latent mechanism
conditions.C3_exact_memory_removed: same training-only set as C1; explicit assertion that A3/B3/C3 is absent
conditions.C4_negative_transfer: historically successful action is ineffective in an unseen manifestation
conditions.C5_safety_override: historically successful action is unsafe in the current world
conditions.C6_uncertainty_ladder: D0 through D4 contexts under a fixed policy
conditions.C7_counterfactual_pair: same seed, observation, simulator, and constraints; memory availability is the only manipulation

leakage_controls: latent mechanism and optimal action exist only in simulator ground truth
runtime observations contain only observable feature vectors and generic failure evidence
A3, B3, and C3 are never inserted into memory
training experiences are fixed before evaluation
distance bands, thresholds, action probabilities, and safety constraints are fixed before evaluation
counterfactual worlds share the same observation id, seed, simulator version, and ground-truth draw sequence
no evaluation outcome is inserted into memory before decision
no frozen experiment directory is written by this protocol
